<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { useDnD, useDnDMonitor } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

// The drag as reactive state, anywhere under the provider.
const { status, active, over, pointer } = useDnD();

const rows = computed(() => [
  { name: 'status', value: status.value },
  { name: 'active', value: active.value?.id ?? '—' },
  { name: 'over', value: over.value?.id ?? '—' },
  { name: 'pointer', value: pointer.value ? `${Math.round(pointer.value.x)}, ${Math.round(pointer.value.y)}` : '—' },
]);

// Every drag's events, wherever it starts. The newest first.
const events = ref<{ id: number; text: string }[]>([]);
let count = 0;
const log = (text: string) => {
  events.value = [{ id: ++count, text }, ...events.value].slice(0, 5);
};

useDnDMonitor({
  onDragStart: ({ active }) => log(`start   ${active.id}`),
  onDragOver: ({ over }) => log(`over    ${over?.id ?? '—'}`),
  onDragEnd: ({ active, over }) => log(`end     ${active.id} → ${over?.id ?? '—'}`),
  onDragCancel: ({ active }) => log(`cancel  ${active.id}`),
});
</script>

import type { CollisionDetection, Coordinates, Rect } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

/** How far the point is from the rect: 0 inside it. */
const gap = (rect: Rect, point: Coordinates) =>
  Math.hypot(
    Math.max(rect.left - point.x, 0, point.x - rect.right),
    Math.max(rect.top - point.y, 0, point.y - rect.bottom),
  );

/**
 * A collision detection of your own: what is under the pointer first; in a gap, the
 * nearest target within 40px of it. Small targets get easier to hit, and empty space
 * far from any target still drops nowhere.
 */
export const magnet: CollisionDetection = ({ hits, pointer, candidates }) => {
  if (hits.length) return hits;
  return candidates
    .filter((candidate) => gap(candidate.rect, pointer) <= 40)
    .sort((a, b) => gap(a.rect, pointer) - gap(b.rect, pointer))
    .map((candidate) => candidate.id);
};

<template>
  <!-- One provider for the page and the popup: the popup shows part of this app. -->
  <DnDProvider>
    <Library />
  </DnDProvider>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { useDnD } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Shelf from './Shelf.vue';

const reading = ref([
  { id: 'dune', title: 'Dune', hue: 32 },
  { id: 'emma', title: 'Emma', hue: 330 },
  { id: 'ulysses', title: 'Ulysses', hue: 210 },
]);
const wishlist = ref([
  { id: 'beloved', title: 'Beloved', hue: 140 },
  { id: 'solaris', title: 'Solaris', hue: 260 },
  { id: 'walden', title: 'Walden', hue: 90 },
]);

const dnd = useDnD();
/** Where the detached shelf renders: the popup's mount point, or nowhere (it stays here). */
const mount = shallowRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
let popup: Window | null = null;
let release: (() => void) | null = null;

const attach = () => {
  release?.();
  release = null;
  mount.value = null;
  popup = null;
};

const detach = () => {
  popup = window.open('', 'wishlist', 'popup,width=360,height=420');
  if (!popup) return;
  const doc = popup.document;
  doc.title = 'Wishlist';
  // A popup has no styles of its own: it gets the page's, as they are now.
  for (const node of document.querySelectorAll('style, link[rel="stylesheet"]')) {
    doc.head.appendChild(node.cloneNode(true));
  }
  doc.body.innerHTML = '';
  doc.body.style.margin = '16px';
  const target = doc.createElement('div');
  doc.body.appendChild(target);
  // The shelf moves there with a teleport, without being mounted again: the provider has
  // to be told about the window.
  release = dnd.addWindow(popup);
  popup.addEventListener('pagehide', attach);
  mount.value = target;
};

const bringBack = () => {
  const opened = popup;
  attach();
  opened?.close();
};

onBeforeUnmount(bringBack);
</script>

<template>
  <div class="library">
    <Shelf id="reading" v-model="reading" title="Reading" />
    <div class="slot">
      <Teleport :to="mount" :disabled="!mount">
        <Shelf id="wishlist" v-model="wishlist" title="Wishlist" />
      </Teleport>
      <p v-if="mount" class="away">The wishlist is in its own window. Sort it there.</p>
      <button type="button" @click="mount ? bringBack() : detach()">
        {{ mount ? 'Bring it back' : 'Open in a window' }}
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</template>
